r: li
Plan and supervise daily fabrication and production activities in accordance with project schedules and priorities.
li
Coordinate structural, piping, welding, assembly, and outfitting activities within assigned work fronts.
li
Monitor productivity, manpower utilization, and progress against planned targets.
li
Review fabrication drawings, work packs, material availability, and construction priorities.
li
Coordinate with Engineering, Planning, QA/QC, HSE, Welding, NDT, and Material Control departments.
li
Ensure fabrication activities comply with approved drawings, procedures, specifications, and quality requirements.
li
Monitor shop-floor activities and resolve production constraints affecting schedule and productivity.
li
Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly production progress reports.
li
Support look-ahead planning, resource allocation, and work-front readiness reviews.
li
Ensure timely closure of quality observations, punch points, and rework items.
li
Promote safe work practices and ensure compliance with all HSE requirements.
li
Participate in production meetings and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
